title: Mobile gaming company Scopely buys a majority stake in Istanbul-based studio Loom, maker of puzzle game Pixel Flow!; a source says the deal values Loom at $1B+ (Georg Szalai/The Hollywood Reporter)
summary: Georg Szalai / The Hollywood Reporter: Mobile gaming company Scopely buys a majority stake in Istanbul-based studio Loom, maker of puzzle game Pixel Flow!; a source says the deal values Loom at $1B+ — “It's been a privilege to have a front row seat to the team's rapid growth and success and see them become the latest Turkish startup …
